description: Reported eleven ticks and refused to round them.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Is named as the person the letter waits for, and is not in the parlour.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Stood by Nick, and was named for the blunders he had batted back.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Left Sam's song alone and told Nick to spend the voice on the last scene.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Turned the talk to the watchet and to Edith's unpaid eight shillings.
name: George Bryan

description: Kept the supper and the debts in their own columns, and would not enter the news as an item.
name: John Heminges

description: Stood by in the black he had worn, and was not asked to tell it again.
name: John Sincler

description: Gave seven pound eleven and said the yard went out quiet.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Said he and Arthur sent the Muscovites back, and that the Princess governed the last scene.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Told him not to make a likeness at the table, and saw that he was somewhere else.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Owned the two stops, and left the messenger's stop as the one that mattered.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Owned the eleven lines and did not apologise.
name: Will Kemp

description: Asked when it was to be, heard tomorrow, and stopped following the gown.
name: William Shakespeare
